states.note: Slight/gross comparative negligence: recovery is only allowed if the plaintiff's fault was "slight" compared to the defendant's "gross" fault — not a percentage-threshold rule, so it cannot be reduced to a barAt/barOperator comparison. Case law (Wood v. City of Crooks) treats fault of 30%+ as more than "slight," but this is decided case-by-case, not by a fixed percentage.
